Tea Collection — Chamomile Tea & Black Tea

Author: SVMods
Version: 2.5.0
Category: Items / Food & Drinks
Required Mod: Content Patcher

About this mod

Tea Collection is a small content pack for Stardew Valley that introduces two new tea drinks to the game: Chamomile Tea and Black Tea!

Whether you want to add a relaxing herbal drink to your daily farm routine or enjoy a classic cup of black tea after a long day of work, this mod brings two new beverages to Gus's Saloon.

Both teas are designed to fit into the game's item system and can be purchased directly from Gus.

New Items

Chamomile Tea

A gentle herbal tea made with chamomile flowers. A pleasant drink to enjoy after a busy day on the farm.

- Price: 150g
- Edibility: 25
- Category: Drinks
- Availability: Always in stock at Gus's Saloon

Black Tea

A classic, rich tea for players who prefer a stronger and more traditional beverage.

- Price: 200g
- Edibility: 40
- Category: Drinks
- Availability: Always in stock at Gus's Saloon

Features

- Adds two new tea items to Stardew Valley.
- Purchase both drinks from Gus's Saloon.
- Both teas remain available in the shop.
- Custom item textures.
- English and Russian item names and descriptions.
- Uses Content Patcher for easy installation.
- No direct changes to the game's original files.

Requirements

This mod requires Content Patcher and a compatible version of Stardew Valley and SMAPI.

Installation

1. Install SMAPI and Content Patcher.
2. Extract the downloaded archive.
3. Place the "[CP] Tea collection" folder inside your Stardew Valley "Mods" folder.
4. Make sure both tea texture files are present in the "assets" folder:
   - "ChamomileTea.png"
   - "BlackTea.png"
5. Launch the game through SMAPI.

Compatibility

This is a Content Patcher content pack. It is designed to add items through the game's data system instead of replacing original game files.

Compatibility with other mods that modify the same item or shop data has not been fully tested.
